scope: Unofficial candidate votes, not ballots, unique voters, party registration or demographic turnout. Party labels and candidate names are literal, including independents and fusion lines; no inferred affiliation. County party totals aggregate only actual county fragments. State party totals include all declared district candidate votes in accepted states, including unlocated returns; an invalid district withholds its entire state rather than publishing a partial state total. Withheld county states retain missing located counts. Absent parties have no invented zero rows; explicitly reported zero candidate votes remain zero.
official_county_scope: PA county fragments only; not full-state or full-district totals.
